cards.quote: Arbore received the Order of Faithful Service, a high distinction conferred by the Romanian government, in recognition of his contributions to Romanian literature and culture. The Order of Faithful Service is a Romanian order established in 1878 to recognize outstanding achievements in various fields, including literature, arts, and public service. The order is divided into several classes, with the highest class being the Grand Cross. According to the Romanian National Archives, Arbore was awarded the Order of Faithful Service in 1885, during the reign of King Carol I of Romania.
